meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 装上后,你说要发布 oh-my-opencode 的一个版本,Claude 就扮演发布管理员:触发 GitHub Actions 发布流程,盯到跑完;核对 GitHub Release、npm 包与 Discord 公告;流程跑挂会报告并停下,不做代码复查或修复。
howto.when: 当你说“publish”“release”等发布指令,并指定把 oh-my-opencode 发到 npm,且给出版本类型(patch、minor、major 或明确版本号)时触发;没给版本类型会先停下来问你。

say.text: publish patch,把 oh-my-opencode 的补丁版发出去。
say.note: 按 patch 跑发布流程,完成后给你发布链接。

say.text: publish minor,发下一个带新功能的小版本。
say.note: 按 minor 发布,并补上更新后的发布说明。
以这个显式版本号触发发布。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as oh-my-opencode's release manager. On a release request it triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, waits for it to finish, verifies the GitHub release, npm packages and Discord announcement, then reports. A failed workflow is reported and stops; no code re-review or fixes happen.
howto.when_en: When you ask to publish/release/deploy oh-my-opencode to npm with a selector (patch, minor, major, or explicit semver), Claude takes over. Without a selector, it stops and asks first.

say_en.text: publish patch — ship the patch release of oh-my-opencode.
say_en.note: Runs the patch workflow and reports with links.

say_en.text: publish minor — release the next feature version.
say_en.note: Runs a minor release and writes the required summary.
Triggers the workflow with that explicit semver.
